==Usage instructions==
<code><nowiki>{{FANvotes|{{subst:FULLPAGENAME}}}}</nowiki></code>

Note:
*Use the actual fullpagename including namespace at the beginning, for example, '''Wookieepedia:Featured article nominations/Onager-class Star Destroyer'''. <span style="color: red;">Do <u>NOT</u> use the magic word <nowiki>{{FULLPAGENAME}}</nowiki> on its own</span> as the vote counts will be zero on pages such as [[Wookieepedia:Featured article nominations]].
